info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Enterprise Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Enterprise Service Update API allows businesses to modify existing legal advisory services using specific parameters. This endpoint is leveraged by financial institutions and service providers seeking to ensure that their legal advisory offerings are up-to-date and accurately reflect client needs. By utilizing the PATCH method, users can selectively update parts of the enterprise service, enhancing flexibility and responsiveness to market demands. Typical consumers include compliance officers and legal teams aiming to maintain service relevance and alignment with regulatory changes.
